title: Agent Message
description: A single typed handoff on the agent bus. Agents communicate through these — carrying POINTERS to blackboard artifacts (refs), not the artifact data itself, to keep inter-agent traffic bounded.

reply_to.description: message_id this message responds to, for threading dynamic-edge dialogues (e.g. critic replying to triage).

from_agent.description: Name of the emitting agent, or 'orchestrator'.

intent.description: task=do this work; result=work product ready; request_info=need more data (e.g. loop back to recon); verdict=judgment on a finding; escalate=hand up to orchestrator for sign-off; done=agent finished its part.

refs.description: Pointers to blackboard artifacts this message concerns (run-dir-relative paths). The receiver reads only what it needs — data does NOT travel inline.

path.description: Run-dir-relative path to the artifact file.

finding_ids.description: Optional subset of finding ids within the artifact this message is scoped to.

payload.description: Small inline structured data — control fields, summaries, verdict counts. NOT bulk artifact data (use refs for that).

cost.description: Audit of the model call that produced this message, if any.

round.description: Loop round for bounded dynamic-edge dialogues (critic reconcile, validator probe loop).
